records.question: John buys 4 pounds of beef.  He uses all but 1 pound in soup.  He uses twice as many pounds of vegetables as beef.  How many pounds of vegetables did he use?
records.response:
John uses 4-1=3 pounds of beef in the soup.
He uses 3*2=6 pounds of vegetables.

records.question: Cary is saving money to buy a new pair of shoes that cost $120. He has already saved $30. He earns $5 for every lawn he mows. If he mows 3 lawns each weekend, how many more weekends will he have to mow lawns before he can afford to buy the shoes?
records.response:
Cary needs to save an additional $120 - $30 = $90.
He earns $5 for each lawn he mows, so he needs to mow 90 / 5 = 18 lawns.
He mows 3 lawns each weekend, so he needs to mow 18 / 3 = 6 more weekends.
#### 6
